title: aquilegia coerulea var. flavescens
intro: Aquilegia coerulea var. flavescens, commonly known as Golden Columbine, is a flowering plant species within the Aquilegia genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Golden Columbine may include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant effects, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
